overloads.semanticRole: Sets, for the current process, whether the current form can be resized horizontally and, if so, its minimum/maximum allowed widths in pixels.

jointConstraints.rule: minWidth and maxWidth are only meaningful when resize is True; if resize is False there is no need to pass them (the form's width becomes fixed regardless of any values given).

constraints: New properties apply only to the current process and are not saved with the form; they override (for this process) whatever was set in the Design environment's Form editor.
If minWidth/maxWidth are omitted while resize is True, the values set in the Design environment (if any) are used instead.
